description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system, which specifies the method println for logging data with severity level, tag, message, and exception details.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging system node capable of outputting log data, supporting chaining with other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.
